composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-115, "AFT SERVICE PUMPS") serves the aft-zone grey/black-water auxiliary pumps: AFT GREY WATER PUMP, PORT/STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP pumps, FWD/AFT CREW HEAD SUMP pumps, and AFT A/C SUMP PUMP — each named directly against its own breaker (Q1-Q6) and terminal-strip row, per the engineer glossary mapping (AFT GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps; PORT/STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, FWD/AFT CREW HEAD SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP -> 530-sump-pumps). A block of remote status/alarm terminals (5,6,8,9 = MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP) are printed on this sheet as REMOTE INDICATOR ROWS only — these belong to their own equipment (520-aux-bilge-pumps, 530-grey-water-pumps, 530-sump-pumps) and are cross-references here, not new circuits, since no pump/motor for those items is drawn on this sheet. The PC CARD / MAIN PANEL terminal strip (T/S C, T/S B, T/S E, T/S F) and MU4-12 multi-core cable are shared distribution infrastructure belonging to 641-vessel-control-panel.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Load name 'AFT GREY WATER P.' directly labels the breaker Q1 row and drives the pump symbol labelled 'AFT GREY WATER PUMP' at right; glossary maps AFT GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps.

functions.label: Aft grey water pump run/alarm control and local ON/OFF/AUTO selection
functions.what_it_does: Runs the aft grey water discharge pump on command from the local S17 ON/OFF/AUTO selector switch, with a run indicator and an alarm output; a level sender reports tank level back to the panel.

flow_scenarios.path: Fed from DC MAIN PANEL breaker Q1 (10A) -> through relay Re12 contact and terminal strip T/S C terminals 76/77/78/79 -> PC CARD RUN IND. (78/79) and ALARM (80/81) outputs monitored; XA61 terminals 10/12 tie into this loop (measured on net21 with Re12/T/S C) and XA61 08 taps the ALARM line -> pump runs to AFT GREY WATER PUMP at right when commanded
S17 selector (ON/OFF/AUTO) at PC CARD -> commands pump run through the Q1-fed relay/terminal circuit -> AFT GREY WATER PUMP motor; RUN IND. lamp on 78/79 lights while running
AFT GREY WATER SENDER (variable resistor symbol) -> SWB02/AFT connector -XA70 pins 07(+)/08(-) -> panel level display (feed/return pair not further traced on this sheet)

infrastructure.system_name: DC Main Panel / PC Card distribution (T/S B, T/S C, T/S E, T/S F terminal strips)
facts: T/S C carries the AFT GREY WATER pump's run/alarm terminals (76-81) alongside PC CARD RUN IND./ALARM readouts and S17 selector.
T/S B terminals 19,20 marked 'not used' — spares.

T/S E terminal 8 feeds EMERGENCY BAT +24V into the panel loop; T/S E terminals 19/20 route into the BACKUP EM POWER/GMDSS BACKUP alarm row; T/S E terminal 57 ties into EMERGENCY LTS SW Link via terminals 10/11/12 -> 103/104/105.
T/S F (right side, 'see DWG-120') terminals 7-12 correspond to terminals 19-24; terminal 22 goes to EMERGENCY LTS SW; terminals 23,24 marked not used (spares).

Remote alarm/status terminal row (terminals 92-96) reports MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP as a shared common-rail net (net216/net282) — these are status indicators for equipment on OTHER sheets/nodes, not pumps driven from this sheet.
MU4-12 multi-core cable links this panel's terminal group to T/S F (per 'see DWG-120') carrying 12 conductors including the EMERGENCY LTS SW line.

good_to_have: Exact fuse rating printed at each '1A' fused terminal symbol near the sump pumps — value is on the drawing.
Re12/Re13/Re14 exact relay part numbers not given, only reference designators — capture at inspection if ever needed.
Q1-Q6 breaker exact trip curve/model — ratings (10A/20A/10A/10A/10A/20A) are printed and captured; part data not needed for function.

G.M. Marine Services contact/letterhead block — company info, not circuit data
Orphan net labels 'net313/net435' (company letterhead text fragments bound to no real device) — discarded as OCR noise, not circuit elements
uncertainties: S17 and S18 selector switches read as ON/OFF/AUTO but the netlist marks their contact state as 'NO' from wiring only (symbol not legible) — cannot confirm which physical position corresponds to auto-run without inspection; function (local selector for the associated pump) is understood, only the exact NO/NC symbol reading is unresolved.

The correspondence between XA61 pins 04/06/02 and specific functions within the Q6/S18/terminals-97-101 group is not individually measured on this sheet (only that they land in that terminal group) — do not assume pin-to-terminal order; flagged per no-interpolation rule.

Terminal group 92-96 (MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP) is on a shared common-rail net (net216) — these are status/alarm inputs for equipment NOT wired for control on this sheet; whether each terminal is a status report or a command into a coil elsewhere is not resolvable from this sheet alone and should be confirmed on the sheet(s) that actually drive those pumps.
